english.note: Use this for a stream, road, or traffic lane flowing into another route or stream.

examples.english: This lane will merge into the main road a little further ahead, so don't get into the wrong lane.
examples.traditional: 呢條行車線再行前少少就會匯入主幹道，唔好揸錯線。
